verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim categorisation, merchant detection, and spending insights on transaction data (yapily-docs-3, yapily-docs-15), directly supporting enrichment as a documented platform capability rather than a DIY task. However, no evidence specifically documents merchant logo enrichment or detailed 'cleaned name' normalization, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of enrichment quality. Missing for 10: explicit logo enrichment documentation, detail on merchant name cleaning methodology, third-party/hands-on validation of enrichment accuracy.
